description: This file implements client-side functions for interacting with the Firecrawl API, including search and scrape functionalities, caching mechanisms, and utility functions for URL resolution and payload parsing.

methods.name: resolveEndpoint
methods.description: Constructs a full API endpoint URL based on the base URL and specified path, ensuring HTTPS and allowed host.

methods.name: postFirecrawlJson
methods.description: Performs a POST request to the Firecrawl API with JSON payload, handling errors and parsing response.

methods.name: resolveSiteName
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the hostname from a URL, removing 'www.' prefix.

methods.name: resolveSearchItems
methods.description: Parses API response payload to extract search items with relevant metadata.

methods.name: buildSearchPayload
methods.description: Builds the search result payload with wrapped content and metadata.

methods.name: runFirecrawlSearch
methods.description: Executes a search query against Firecrawl API, utilizing caching and response parsing.

methods.name: resolveScrapeData
methods.description: Extracts data object from API response payload.

methods.name: parseFirecrawlScrapePayload
methods.description: Parses and formats the scrape response, including content truncation and wrapping.

methods.name: runFirecrawlScrape
methods.description: Performs a web page scrape via Firecrawl API, with caching and error handling.
